checks.name: model:quasi_static_and_material_limitations_are_explicit
checks.detail: Nc, bandgap, mobility, contacts, and background doping remain teaching assumptions rather than a jointly calibrated IGZO material set. Local equilibrium occupancy has no capture cross section or time constant and cannot produce hysteresis or bias-stress dynamics. Only acceptor-like NTA and NGA are included; donor-like NTD and NGD are deferred. The source device and bias differ from this project, so the literature values are sensitivity inputs rather than project measurements.
